game_title: Fallback: Times Table Garden – Firefly Meadow
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the forest ranger must hold off cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Times Table Garden: Plant a grid of mana petals using nested for loops for rows and columns.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: In Firefly Meadow, repeat each round: Plant a grid of mana petals using nested for loops for rows and columns. Then check garden_cells and advance.
player_objective: Protect the herb garden from cursed treants in Firefly Meadow: keep garden_cells above zero until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Times Table Garden
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 6, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
